1778-2511-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Memnite is starting in your graveyard.
1778-2511-5006-8170.description:
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Memnite spell. Then, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Memnite, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur
Repeat.

240-5470-6968-8249.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat from step 2.

1170-2981-5131-6595--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2981-5131-6595--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Lyse Hext.
Displacer Kitten and Lyse Hext's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the Lyse Hext trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Megatog +3/+3 until end of turn
Repeat.

2043-4478-7826.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Bag End Banquet that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
When the Bag End Banquet token enters, it triggers, creating three Food tokens.
Activate the Bag End Banquet token by tapping it, adding {C} for each Food you control.
Repeat
2043-4478-7826.notes: You can reduce the cost by up to {3} if you control additional Food(s) as you start the combo. You can also tap the original Bag End Banquet for mana after the Foods are created initially if you're able to do so.

1379-2685-3197-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1379-2685-3197-6996.description:
Gain life in any way.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

215-850-5295.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures with defender.
215-850-5295.description:
Activate Overgrown Battlement by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Overgrown Battlement from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Overgrown Battlement by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

112-2104-7757.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U} the first turn with {3}{U} each extra turn
112-2104-7757.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack and that cannot be blocked or killed by an opponent.
112-2104-7757.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Declare any creature as an attacker. When you do, Doom's Time Platform triggers, exiling Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard with two time counters on it.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Temporal Manipulation's suspend ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, removing a time counter from Temporal Manipulation and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Temporal Manipulation's suspend ability triggers, causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 2 each turn.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-5319-6972.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Geralf's Messenger
When Geralf's Messenger dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Messenger enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Geralf's Messenger trigger, causing an opponent to lose 2 life.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Geralf's Messenger
When Geralf's Messenger dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat steps 3 through 5 once.
Resolve the Blasting Station abilities from step 1 and 6.
Repeat.
413-5319-6972.notes: If Geralf's Messenger starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 6 instead.

856-3967-5776-7422.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Garrison Excavator trigger.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

891-3055-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
Repeat.

3094-4659-5390-7296-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
3094-4659-5390-7296-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {2} due to Forensic Gadgeteer and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed, targeting Lithoform Engine.
Resolve the copy of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine from your graveyard to the battlefield as a 3/3 Robot artifact creature.
Repeat from step 2.

2743-4483-5776.notablePrerequisites: You have cast your commander from the command zone at least twice this game.
2743-4483-5776.description:
Cast Echo Storm by paying {3}{U}{U}, targeting Biovisionary.
Echo Storm triggers, copying it for each time you've cast from the command zone this game, with each copy targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Echo Storms, creating that  make copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

276-2191-4416.notablePrerequisites: You are able to deal damage to a creature.
276-2191-4416.description:
Cast Martyrdom by paying {1}{W}{W}, targeting Phyrexian Vindicator.
Activate Phyrexian Vindicator by paying {0}, targeting a creature.
Attempt to deal damage to the targeted creature. The damage will then be increased due to Angrath's Marauders, then redirected to Phyrexian Vindicator, which is then redirected back to the creature that was originally targeted.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Vindicator by paying {0}, targeting the creature. 
Repeat step 4 until all damage will be redirected to Phyrexian Vindicator.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a film counter on it

57-2079-4846-6924.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-2079-4846-6924.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Peter Parker's Camera by paying {2}, tapping and removing a film counter from it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1734-2034-3817.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from exile to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Repeat from step 3.

3652-5220-5330-6900.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Ornithopter
When Ornithopter dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Ornithopter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Cast Ornithopter from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

1557-1651-3263-5640.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping it and Siren of the Silent Song, targeting Siren of the Silent Song.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying Clock of Omens' ability, targeting Clock of Omens.
Resolve both Clock of Omens  abilities, untapping it and Siren of the Silent Song.
Siren of the Silent Song triggers, causing each opponent to discard and mill a card.
Repeat.

593-4083-4090.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal damage to Mogg Maniac.
Mogg Maniac is indestructible.
593-4083-4090.description:
Deal damage to Mogg Maniac.
Mogg Maniac and Repercussion trigger.
Resolve the Mogg Maniac trigger, dealing damage to an applicable target.
Resolve the Repercussion trigger, dealing damage to Mogg Maniac instead of you due to Pariah.
Repeat from step 2.

2957-4231-4508-5880.description:
Activate Imagecrafter by tapping it, causing Magmaw to become a Pirate until end of turn.
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure, Food and Clue token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

1661-1987-4423-6700.easyPrerequisites:
You have the initiative.
You control three additional Islands.
1661-1987-4423-6700.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Sarevok's Tome by tapping them, adding {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Sarevok's Tome.
When Mystic Sanctuary and Sarevok's Tome enters untapped, they trigger.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sarevok's Tome trigger, causing you to take the initiative.
Repeat.

1789-2438-4452-5649.notablePrerequisites: Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Dragon" chosen.
1789-2438-4452-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

586-5011-5406-5686.description:
Activate Dinosaur Headdress' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to Priest of Gix and causing Priest of Gix to become a copy of Cavalier of Night.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, its second ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

49-1799-2034-3862.notablePrerequisites: You do not control an Army.
49-1799-2034-3862.description:
Activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, putting Orcish Bowmasters on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Orcish Bowmasters into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Orcish Bowmasters enters the battlefield, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target, then creating a 0/0 Orc Army creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Army and Orcish Bowmasters, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

654-683-1541-4050-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact, enchantment or token.
654-683-1541-4050-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Tenacious Tomeseeker, adding {R}.
When Tenacious Tomeseeker dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Tenacious Tomeseeker on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Hit the Mother Lode by paying {4}{R}{R}{R}, exiling Tenacious Tomeseeker from the top of your library and casting it without paying its mana cost, sacrificing an artifact, enchantment or token to its Bargain ability, and creating seven tapped Treasure artifact tokens.
When the Treasures enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers seven times, untapping the Treasures.
Tenacious Tomeseeker enters the battlefield, triggering itself, returning Hit the Mother Lode from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

225-1021-2953-4693.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
Dawn's Reflection attached to any mana-producing land you control.
225-1021-2953-4693.description:
Activate the land with Dawn's Reflection attached by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Dawn's Reflection triggers, adding {2}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land.
Activate Drownyard Temple by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Drownyard Temple enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat.
